deckTitle: Shin Kanzen Master N3 Grammar - Sentence Deck

cards.frontSentence: <ruby>日本<rt>にほん</rt></ruby>に【…】<ruby>一度<rt>いちど</rt></ruby><ruby>富士<rt>ふじ</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt>やま</rt></ruby>に<ruby>登<rt>のぼ</rt></ruby>ってみたい。
cards.backSentence: 日本にほんにいるうちに一度いちど富士ふじ山やまに登のぼってみたい。
cards.translation: I want to climb Mt. Fuji once while I am in Japan.
cards.richGrammarFormation: <ruby>名<rt>な</rt></ruby>の・<ruby>動辞<rt>どうじ</rt></ruby><ruby>書<rt>しょ</rt></ruby><ruby>形<rt>けい</rt></ruby> / ている / ない<ruby>形<rt>かたち</rt></ruby>・イ<ruby>形<rt>がた</rt></ruby>い・ナ<ruby>形<rt>がた</rt></ruby>な ＋ うちに
cards.additionalNotes: ~ indicates a certain state before a change occurs; ... is a clause expressing a volitional action.
cards.detailedExplanation:
日本にほんにいるうちに一度いちど富士ふじ山やまに登のぼってみたい。

🏗️ Sentence Structure

This sentence consists of a main clause expressing a desire to try an action, preceded by a temporal clause indicating the period during which that action is desired.

[Sentence] - [Temporal Clause] - [Location Phrase] - [Noun] 日本 (Japan) - [Particle] に (in) - [Verb] いる (be) - [Grammar Pattern] うちに (while) - [Main Clause] - [Adverb] 一度 (once) - [Destination Phrase] - [Noun] 富士山 (Mt. Fuji) - [Particle] に (to) - [Verb Phrase (Desire to Try)] - [Verb (て-form)] 登のぼって (climbing) - [Auxiliary Verb] み (try) - [Auxiliary Adjective] たい (want to)

🔍 Word-by-Word Breakdown

  • 日本（にほん）— Japan · noun
  • に（に）— in, at · particle (indicating location)
  • いる（いる）— to be (animate) · verb (dictionary form)
  • うちに（うちに）— while, during · grammar pattern (indicating "while a certain state continues")
  • 一度（いちど）— once, one time · adverb
  • 富士山（ふじさん）— Mt. Fuji · noun
  • に（に）— to, toward · particle (indicating destination)
  • 登のぼって（のぼって）— climbing (and) · verb (て-form of 登のぼる)
  • みたい（みたい）— want to try · auxiliary adjective (combining ～てみる "to try" with ～たい "want to")

cards.frontSentence: はい、アイスクリーム。【…】<ruby>早<rt>はや</rt></ruby>く<ruby>食<rt>た</rt></ruby>べてくださいね。
cards.backSentence: はい、アイスクリーム。溶とけないうちに早はやく食たべてくださいね。
cards.translation: Here, have an ice cream. Please eat it quickly before it melts.
cards.richGrammarFormation: <ruby>名<rt>な</rt></ruby>の・<ruby>動辞<rt>どうじ</rt></ruby><ruby>書<rt>しょ</rt></ruby><ruby>形<rt>けい</rt></ruby> / ている / ない<ruby>形<rt>かたち</rt></ruby>・イ<ruby>形<rt>がた</rt></ruby>い・ナ<ruby>形<rt>がた</rt></ruby>な ＋ うちに
cards.additionalNotes: ~ indicates a certain state before a change occurs; ... is a clause expressing a volitional action.
cards.detailedExplanation:
はい、アイスクリーム。溶とけないうちに早はやく食たべてくださいね。

🏗️ Sentence Structure

This sentence consists of an introductory greeting and offering, followed by a main clause containing a temporal condition "before it melts" and a polite request.

[Sentence] - [Interjection/Offering Phrase] - はい (Yes/Here) - アイスクリーム (ice cream) - [Main Request Clause] - [Temporal Clause] - 溶とけない (not melt) - うちに (before/while) - 早はやく (quickly) - 食たべて (eat - [te-form]

🔍 Word-by-Word Breakdown

  • はい（はい）— Yes/Here you go · interjection
  • 、（、）— comma · punctuation
  • アイスクリーム（アイスクリーム）— ice cream · noun
  • 。（。）— period · punctuation
  • 溶とけない（とけない）— not melt · negative form of verb 溶とける (to melt)
  • うちに（うちに）— while/before · grammar pattern particle
  • 早はやく（はやく）— quickly · adverb
  • 食たべて（たべて）— eat · te-form of verb 食たべる (to eat)
  • ください（ください）— please do · auxiliary verb for polite request
  • ね（ね）— right? / emphatic particle · sentence-ending particle

cards.frontSentence: <ruby>音楽<rt>おんがく</rt></ruby>を【…】<ruby>眠<rt>ねむ</rt></ruby>ってしまった。
cards.backSentence: 音楽おんがくを聞きいているうちに眠ねむってしまった。
cards.translation: While I was listening to music, I fell asleep.
cards.richGrammarFormation: <ruby>動辞<rt>どうじ</rt></ruby><ruby>書<rt>しょ</rt></ruby><ruby>形<rt>けい</rt></ruby> / ている / ない<ruby>形<rt>かたち</rt></ruby> ＋ うちに
cards.additionalNotes: ~ indicates a continuous state; ... indicates a change; ... cannot express a volitional action by the speaker.
cards.detailedExplanation:
音楽おんがくを聞きいているうちに眠ねむってしまった。

🏗️ Sentence Structure

This sentence describes an action (falling asleep) that occurred during the process of another ongoing action (listening to music).

[ [音楽おんがくを 聞きいている うちに] [眠ねむってしまった]] [音楽おんがくを 聞きいている うちに] (Adverbial Clause: "while listening to music") [音楽] (Noun: "music") [を] (Particle: direct object marker) [聞きいて] (Verb stem: "listen" in て-form) [いる] (Auxiliary Verb: "be" indicating continuous action) [うちに] (Grammar Pattern: "while, during the period of") [眠ねむってしまった] (Main Clause: "fell asleep") [眠ねむって] (Verb stem: "fall asleep" in て-form) [しまった] (Auxiliary Verb: "finished completely," indicating unintended consequence or completion)

🔍 Word-by-Word Breakdown

  • 音楽（おんがく）— music · noun
  • を（を）— (direct object marker) · particle
  • 聞きい（きい）— listen (て-form stem) · verb
  • て（て）— (linking particle) · particle
  • いる（いる）— be · auxiliary verb
  • うち（うち）— while; during · noun, part of grammar pattern
  • に（に）— (particle indicating time/situation) · particle
  • 眠ねむっ（ねむっ）— fall asleep (て-form stem) · verb
  • て（て）— (linking particle) · particle
  • しまっ（しまっ）— finish; completely (て-form stem) · auxiliary verb
  • た（た）— (past tense marker) · auxiliary verb

cards.frontSentence: お<ruby>母<rt>はは</rt></ruby>さんが【…】、<ruby>子<rt>こ</rt></ruby>どもたちはテレビを<ruby>見<rt>み</rt></ruby>ていた。
cards.backSentence: お母ははさんが昼寝ひるねをしている間あいだ、子こどもたちはテレビを見みていた。
cards.translation: While Mom was taking a nap, the children were watching TV.
cards.richGrammarFormation: <ruby>名<rt>な</rt></ruby>の・<ruby>動辞<rt>どうじ</rt></ruby><ruby>書<rt>しょ</rt></ruby><ruby>形<rt>けい</rt></ruby> / ている / ない<ruby>形<rt>かたち</rt></ruby> ＋ <ruby>間<rt>あいだ</rt></ruby>
cards.additionalNotes: ~ indicates a continuous state; ... also indicates a continuous state.
cards.detailedExplanation:
お母ははさんが昼寝ひるねをしている間あいだ、子こどもたちはテレビを見みていた。

🏗️ Sentence Structure

The sentence consists of a subordinate temporal clause describing an action, followed by a main clause describing an action performed simultaneously.

[Sentence] - [Subordinate Clause (Temporal)] - [Subject] お母ははさん (Mom) - [Particle] が (subject marker) - [Verb Phrase] 昼寝 を している (taking a nap) - [Temporal Noun] 間 (while/during) - [Punctuation] 、 (comma) - [Main Clause] - [Topic] 子こどもたち (the children) - [Particle] は (topic marker) - [Verb Phrase] テレビ を 見みていた (were watching TV)

🔍 Word-by-Word Breakdown

  • お母ははさん（おかあさん）— mother · noun
  • が（が）— (subject particle) · particle
  • 昼寝（ひるね）— nap · noun
  • を（を）— (direct object particle) · particle
  • し（し）— to do (stem of する) · verb stem
  • て（て）— (te-form particle) · particle
  • いる（いる）— to be (auxiliary verb indicating ongoing action) · auxiliary verb
  • 間（あいだ）— while; during · noun, temporal conjunction
  • 、（、）— comma · punctuation
  • 子こどもたち（こどもたち）— children · noun
  • は（は）— (topic particle) · particle
  • テレビ（テレビ）— television · noun
  • を（を）— (direct object particle) · particle
  • 見（み）— to watch (stem of 見みる) · verb stem
  • て（て）— (te-form particle) · particle
  • いた（いた）— was/were (past tense of いる, indicating ongoing action in the past) · auxiliary verb

cards.frontSentence: お<ruby>母<rt>はは</rt></ruby>さんが【…】、<ruby>子<rt>こ</rt></ruby>どもたちは<ruby>遊<rt>あそ</rt></ruby>びに<ruby>出<rt>で</rt></ruby>かけた。
cards.backSentence: お母ははさんが昼寝ひるねをしている間あいだに、子こどもたちは遊あそびに出でかけた。
cards.translation: While Mother was taking a nap, the children went out to play.
cards.richGrammarFormation: <ruby>名<rt>な</rt></ruby>の・<ruby>動辞<rt>どうじ</rt></ruby><ruby>書<rt>しょ</rt></ruby><ruby>形<rt>けい</rt></ruby> / ている / ない<ruby>形<rt>かたち</rt></ruby> ＋ <ruby>間<rt>あいだ</rt></ruby>に
cards.additionalNotes: ~ indicates a continuous state; ... indicates a momentary action or change.
cards.detailedExplanation:
お母ははさんが昼寝ひるねをしている間あいだに、子こどもたちは遊あそびに出でかけた。

🏗️ Sentence Structure

This sentence consists of a temporal subordinate clause indicating "while/during" followed by a main clause describing the action that occurred.

[Sentence] - [Temporal Clause] - [Subject お母ははさん] が - [Verb Phrase 昼寝 を して] いる - [Temporal Marker] 間あいだに - [Main Clause] - [Topic 子こどもたち] は - [Purpose Clause 遊あそび] に - [Verb] 出でかけた

🔍 Word-by-Word Breakdown

  • お母ははさん（おかあさん）— mother · noun
  • が（が）— particle · subject marker
  • 昼寝（ひるね）— nap · noun
  • を（を）— particle · direct object marker
  • して（して）— doing · te-form of the verb する (to do)
  • いる（いる）— is · auxiliary verb, indicating ongoing action (part of ている)
  • 間（あいだ）— interval, duration · noun
  • に（に）— particle · temporal marker (during, while)
  • 、（、）— comma · punctuation
  • 子こどもたち（こどもたち）— children · noun (子こども "child" + たち plural suffix)
  • は（は）— particle · topic marker
  • 遊あそび（あそび）— playing · noun (stem of the verb 遊あそぶ "to play", used nominally to indicate purpose)
  • に（に）— particle · purpose marker (for the purpose of)
  • 出でかけた（でかけた）— went out · verb (past tense of 出でかける "to go out")

cards.frontSentence: <ruby>明<rt>あか</rt></ruby>るい【…】<ruby>庭<rt>にわ</rt></ruby>の<ruby>掃除<rt>そうじ</rt></ruby>をしてしまおう。
cards.backSentence: 明あかるいうちに庭にわの掃除そうじをしてしまおう。
cards.translation: Let's clean the garden while it's still bright.
cards.richGrammarFormation: <ruby>名<rt>な</rt></ruby>の・<ruby>動辞<rt>どうじ</rt></ruby><ruby>書<rt>しょ</rt></ruby><ruby>形<rt>けい</rt></ruby> / ている / ない<ruby>形<rt>かたち</rt></ruby>・イ<ruby>形<rt>がた</rt></ruby>い・ナ<ruby>形<rt>がた</rt></ruby>な ＋ うちに
cards.additionalNotes: ~ indicates a certain state before a change occurs; ... is a clause expressing a volitional action.
cards.detailedExplanation:
明あかるいうちに庭にわの掃除そうじをしてしまおう。

🏗️ Sentence Structure

This sentence consists of a main clause, 「庭にわの掃除そうじをしてしまおう」 (Let's clean the garden), modified by the adverbial phrase 「明あかるいうちに」 (while it's still bright), indicating the time frame for the action.

[Sentence] - [Time Phrase] 明あかるいうちに - [Adjective 明あかるい] (bright) - [Noun うち] (while/during) - [Particle に] (at/in) - [Main Clause] 庭にわの掃除そうじをしてしまおう - [Noun 庭] (garden) - [Particle の] ('s/of) - [Noun 掃除] (cleaning) - [Particle を (object] marker) - [Verb Phrase] してしまおう - [Verb する (to do) in] て-form - [Auxiliary Verb しまう (to finish) in volitional form]

🔍 Word-by-Word Breakdown

  • 明あかるい（あかるい）— bright · い-adjective
  • うち（うち）— while; during · noun
  • に（に）— in; at; during · particle
  • 庭（にわ）— garden · noun
  • の（の）— 's; of · particle
  • 掃除（そうじ）— cleaning · noun
  • を（を）— direct object marker · particle
  • して（して）— doing; having done · verb (て-form of する)
  • しまおう（しまおう）— let's finish; let's complete · verb (volitional form of しまう)

cards.frontSentence: <ruby>少<rt>すこ</rt></ruby>し<ruby>難<rt>むずか</rt></ruby>しい<ruby>曲<rt>きょく</rt></ruby>でも、<ruby>練習<rt>れんしゅう</rt></ruby>を【…】<ruby>弾<rt>ひ</rt></ruby>けるようになりますよ。
cards.backSentence: 少すこし難むずかしい曲きょくでも、練習れんしゅうを重かさねるうちに弾ひけるようになりますよ。
cards.translation: Even if it's a slightly difficult song, you'll become able to play it as you keep practicing.
cards.richGrammarFormation: <ruby>動辞<rt>どうじ</rt></ruby><ruby>書<rt>しょ</rt></ruby><ruby>形<rt>けい</rt></ruby> / ている / ない<ruby>形<rt>かたち</rt></ruby> ＋ うちに
cards.additionalNotes: ~ indicates a continuous state; ... indicates a change; ... cannot express a volitional action by the speaker.
cards.detailedExplanation:
少すこし難むずかしい曲きょくでも、練習れんしゅうを重かさねるうちに弾ひけるようになりますよ。

🏗️ Sentence Structure

This sentence describes a change in ability that occurs over time, presented with a concessive condition.

[Sentence] - [Concessive Clause] 少すこし難むずかしい曲きょくでも - [Adjective Phrase] 少すこし難むずかしい - [Adverb] 少すこし - [い-Adjective] 難むずかしい - [Noun] 曲 - [Concessive Particle] でも - [Temporal Clause] 練習れんしゅうを重かさねるうちに - [Noun] 練習 - [Object Marker] を - [Verb] 重かさねる - [Temporal Particle Pattern] うちに - [Main Clause] 弾ひけるようになりますよ - [Potential Verb] 弾ひける - [Change of State Pattern] ようになります - [Emphatic Particle] よ

🔍 Word-by-Word Breakdown

  • 少すこし（すこし）— a little, a bit · adverb
  • 難むずかしい（むずかしい）— difficult · い-adjective
  • 曲（きょく）— song, musical piece · noun
  • でも（でも）— even if, even though · particle indicating concession
  • 練習（れんしゅう）— practice · noun
  • を（を）— direct object marker · particle
  • 重かさねる（かさねる）— to pile up, to repeat · transitive verb
  • うちに（うちに）— while, during, as · grammar pattern indicating a change occurs within a period or before a situation changes
  • 弾ひける（ひける）— to be able to play (an instrument) · potential form of 弾ひく (ひく)
  • ようになる（ようになる）— to come to be able to do, to become able to · auxiliary verb phrase expressing a change of state
  • ます（ます）— polite affirmative ending · auxiliary verb
  • よ（よ）— sentence-ending particle indicating assurance or emphasis · particle

cards.frontSentence: <ruby>気<rt>き</rt></ruby>がつかない【…】<ruby>外<rt>そと</rt></ruby>は<ruby>暗<rt>くら</rt></ruby>くなっていた。
cards.backSentence: 気きがつかないうちに外そとは暗くらくなっていた。
cards.translation: Without me noticing, it had gotten dark outside.
cards.richGrammarFormation: <ruby>動辞<rt>どうじ</rt></ruby><ruby>書<rt>しょ</rt></ruby><ruby>形<rt>けい</rt></ruby> / ている / ない<ruby>形<rt>かたち</rt></ruby> ＋ うちに
cards.additionalNotes: ~ indicates a continuous state; ... indicates a change; ... cannot express a volitional action by the speaker.
cards.detailedExplanation:
気きがつかないうちに外そとは暗くらくなっていた。

🏗️ Sentence Structure

This sentence consists of a temporal dependent clause modifying a main clause, indicating an action or state change occurring unnoticed during a specific period.

[Sentence] - [Temporal Clause] - [Verb Phrase] - [Noun: 気] (mind) - [Particle: が (subject] marker) - [Verb Stem: つか] (notice) - [Negative Auxiliary: ない] (not) - [Noun/Particle: うちに (while,] during) - [Main Clause] - [Topic Phrase] - [Noun: 外] (outside) - [Particle: は (topic] marker) - [Verb Phrase] - [I-Adjective (adverbial form): 暗くらく] (dark) - [Verb: なっ] (become) - [Connective Particle:] て - [Auxiliary Verb: いた (was - past] continuous/state)

🔍 Word-by-Word Breakdown

  • 気（き）— mind; spirit · noun (part of the idiom 気きがつく)
  • が（が）— subject marker · particle (part of the idiom 気きがつく)
  • つか（つか）— to notice (verb stem of 気きがつく) · verb stem
  • ない（ない）— not · negative auxiliary
  • うちに（うちに）— while; during; before (something happens) · grammar pattern particle
  • 外（そと）— outside · noun
  • は（は）— topic marker · particle
  • 暗くらく（くらく）— dark (adverbial form) · i-adjective stem in adverbial form
  • なっ（なっ）— to become (verb stem of なる) · verb stem
  • て（て）— connective particle (te-form) · particle
  • いた（いた）— was (past tense of auxiliary verb いる, indicating a continuous state) · auxiliary verb

cards.frontSentence: わたしが<ruby>旅行<rt>りょこう</rt></ruby>で<ruby>留守<rt>るす</rt></ruby>の【…】、<ruby>庭<rt>にわ</rt></ruby>に<ruby>草<rt>くさ</rt></ruby>がたくさん<ruby>生<rt>は</rt></ruby>えてしまった。

🔍 逐词与语法精讲

  • ⭐ N3 核心考点 - ～なければいい:
    • 接续: 名词 ＋ で ＋ なければ ＋ いい
    • 含义: 期き望もち不ふ好こう的てき事情じじょう不要ふよう发生。“如果じょか不ふ是ぜ坏つき病びょう就好了りょう”。句く尾お的てき“が”留とめ下か一いち点てん担たん忧的余よ韵いん。
cards.detailedExplanation:
最近さいきんずっと体からだの調子ちょうしが悪わるい。悪わるい病気びょうきでなければいいが……。

🏗️ Sentence Structure

This sentence consists of two main clauses: an initial statement describing a physical condition, followed by a wish or hope concerning a potential cause, connected by a conjunctive particle implying lingering concern.

[Sentence] - [Clause 1:] 最近さいきんずっと体からだの調子ちょうしが悪わるい。 - [Adverbial Phrase:] 最近 - [Adverb:] ずっと - [Subject Phrase:] 体からだの調子ちょうし - [Modifier:] 体からだの - [Noun:] 調子 - [Subject Marker:] が - [Predicate:] 悪わるい - [Clause 2:] 悪わるい病気びょうきでなければいいが……。 - [Attributive Adjective:] 悪わるい - [Noun Phrase:] 病気 - [Noun:] 病気 - [Conditional Negative Copula Phrase:] でなければ - [Copula Particle:] で - [Negative Conditional Stem:] なけれ - [Conditional Particle:] ば - [Predicate (Expressing Hope/Wish):] いい - [Conjunctive Particle:] が - [Punctuation: ……]

🔍 Word-by-Word Breakdown

  • 最近（さいきん）— recently, lately · temporal adverb
  • ずっと（ずっと）— all the time, continuously · adverb
  • 体（からだ）— body · noun (part of a genitive phrase)
  • の（の）— possessive/modifying particle · particle
  • 調子（ちょうし）— condition, state · noun
  • が（が）— subject marker · particle
  • 悪わるい（わるい）— bad, poor · i-adjective (predicate)
  • 。（まる）— period · punctuation mark
  • 悪わるい（わるい）— bad, serious · i-adjective (attributive)
  • 病気（びょうき）— illness, sickness · noun
  • で（で）— copula particle (part of the conditional form) · particle
  • なけれ（なけれ）— negative conditional stem of the copula · auxiliary verb conjugation
  • ば（ば）— conditional conjunction · particle
  • いい（いい）— good · i-adjective (predicate, expressing hope or wish)
  • が（が）— but, however · conjunctive particle
  • ……（てんてんてん）— ellipsis · punctuation mark

  • ⭐ N3 核心考点 - ～たらどうか:

cards.frontSentence: <ruby>迷惑<rt>めいわく</rt></ruby>メールが<ruby>多<rt>おお</rt></ruby>いの？じゃ、アドレスを<ruby>変<rt>か</rt></ruby>え【…】？

Can also be used to blame someone for not having taken such an action already.

迷惑めいわくメールが多おおいの？じゃ、アドレスを変かえたらどう？

🔍 逐词与语法精讲

  • ⭐ N3 核心考点 - ～たらどう:
    • 接续: 动词た形かたち ＋ ら ＋ どう
    • 含义: 朋友之间比较随便的口语建议，“换个邮箱不就行了嘛/如何？”。

迷惑めいわくメールが多おおいの？じゃ、アドレスを変かえたらどう？

This sentence consists of two independent clauses: an initial question regarding the volume of spam emails, followed by a suggestion that is introduced by the conversational filler "じゃ."

[Sentence] - [Clause 1] (Question) - [Subject Phrase] (迷惑めいわくメールが多おおい) - [迷惑めいわくメール (Noun) (spam] email) - [が (Particle) (subject] marker) - [多おおい (I-adjective)] (many) - [の (Particle) (explanatory/question] particle) - [？ (Punctuation) (question] mark) - [Connection] (じゃ) - [Clause 2] (Suggestion) - [アドレス (Noun)] (address) - [を (Particle) (direct object] marker) - [変かえたらどう？ (Verb + たらどう pattern) (How about] changing?) - [変かえ (Verb stem)] (change) - [たら (Conditional particle)] (if) - [どう (Question word)] (how) - [？ (Punctuation) (question] mark)

  • を（を）— indicates the direct object of a verb · particle
  • 変かえ（かえ）— change · verb stem (from 変かえる - to change)

~ is a verb expressing a volitional action.

冷蔵れいぞう庫こがこわれたので、新あたらしいのを買かうことにした。

🔍 逐词与语法精讲

  • ⭐ N3 核心考点 - ～ことにする:

cards.detailedExplanation:
冷蔵れいぞう庫こがこわれたので、新あたらしいのを買かうことにした。

🏗️ Sentence Structure

This is a compound sentence consisting of two clauses linked by a causal conjunction, where the first clause states the reason for the decision made in the second clause.

[Sentence] - [Clause: 冷蔵れいぞう庫こがこわれた (The refrigerator] broke) - [Conjunction: ので] (because) - [Clause: 新あたらしいのを買かうことにした (I decided to buy a new] one)

  • ご本ほん（ごほん）— (your/his) book · noun phrase
  • ご（ご）— respectful prefix · prefix
  • 本（ほん）— book · noun
  • を（を）— direct object marker · particle

  • お（お）— humble prefix · prefix

  • 会場（かいじょう）— venue · noun

cards.richGrammarFormation: お<ruby>目<rt>め</rt></ruby>にかかる
cards.additionalNotes:
None

あした3時ときに(先生せんせいに)お目めにかかります。

🔍 逐词与语法精讲

  • ⭐ N3 核心考点 - 謙譲語１ (特殊动词):
    • 普通说法: 会あう（会あいます）
    • 含义: 「お目めにかかる」是ぜ「会あう」的てき最高さいこう级别自じ谦语（拜会）。
cards.detailedExplanation:
あした3時ときに(先生せんせいに)お目めにかかります。

🏗️ Sentence Structure

This sentence uses an adverbial phrase of time and an optional indirect object phrase to describe when and with whom the humble action of meeting will occur.

[Sentence] - [Time Adverb] あした - [Time Phrase 3時] に - [Indirect Object Phrase (先生] に) - [Verb Phrase] お目めにかかります

🔍 Word-by-Word Breakdown

  • あした（ashita）— tomorrow · Noun functioning as a time adverb
  • 3時（sanji）— 3 o'clock · Noun, specific time
  • に（ni）— at · Particle indicating a specific time
  • (（）— ( · Punctuation, opening parenthesis
  • 先生（sensei）— teacher · Noun
  • に（ni）— to · Particle indicating the person one meets
  • )（）— ) · Punctuation, closing parenthesis
  • お目めにかかります（ome ni kakarimasu）— will meet · Humble verb "to meet" (謙譲語 of 会あう) in its polite non-past/future form

cards.frontSentence: (<ruby>先生<rt>せんせい</rt></ruby>に)<ruby>本<rt>ほん</rt></ruby>を【…】。

None

    • 普通说法: あげる（あげます）

(先生せんせいに)本ほんをさしあげます。

🏗️ Sentence Structure

This sentence expresses the act of giving an object to a recipient using a humble verb form.

[Sentence] - [Indirect Object] (先生せんせいに) - [Noun] (先生) - [Particle] (に) - [Direct Object] (本ほんを) - [Noun] (本) - [Particle] (を) - [Verb] (さしあげます)

  • (先生（せんせい）— teacher · noun
  • に（に）— to/for · indirect object particle
  • 本（ほん）— book · noun
  • を（を）— direct object marker · particle
  • さしあげます（さしあげる）— to humbly give/offer · humble verb, polite form

cards.frontSentence: あした3<ruby>時<rt>とき</rt></ruby>に【…】。
cards.backSentence: あした3時ときに参まいります。
cards.translation: I will come/go at 3 o'clock tomorrow.
cards.richGrammarFormation: <ruby>参<rt>まい</rt></ruby>る
cards.grammarExplanation: Polite humble form of 行く/来る
cards.additionalNotes:
It does not elevate the other party, but simply expresses the speaker's own polite attitude.

あした3時ときに参まいります。

🔍 逐词与语法精讲

  • ⭐ N3 核心考点 - 謙譲語２ (丁重語):
    • 普通说法: 来くる / 行いく（来きます/行いきます）
    • 含义: 「参まいる」表示ひょうじ自己じこ来らい/去。它不直接抬高对方，而是通过极度郑重的措辞表达自身的修养和礼貌（多用于广播、自我介绍等）。
cards.detailedExplanation:
あした3時ときに参まいります。

🏗️ Sentence Structure

This sentence follows a basic structure of a time adverbial phrase followed by a humble verb, with the subject implied as the speaker.

[Sentence] - [Time Phrase] - [あした] (tomorrow) - [3時 (3] o'clock) - [に] (at) - [Verb Phrase] - [参まいります (will come/go,] humble)

🔍 Word-by-Word Breakdown

  • あした（ashita）— tomorrow · noun, adverbial modifier
  • 3時（sanji）— 3 o'clock · noun
  • に（ni）— at · particle, indicating time
  • 参まいります（mairimasu）— will come/go · verb (謙譲語II of 来くる/行いく), polite form (ます-form)

cards.frontSentence: <ruby>夜<rt>よる</rt></ruby>は<ruby>家<rt>いえ</rt></ruby>に【…】。
cards.backSentence: 夜よるは家いえにおります。
cards.translation: I will be at home at night.
cards.richGrammarFormation: おる
cards.grammarExplanation: Polite humble form of いる
cards.additionalNotes:
None

夜よるは家いえにおります。

🔍 逐词与语法精讲

  • ⭐ N3 核心考点 - 謙譲語２ (丁重語):
    • 普通说法: いる（います）
    • 含义: 「おる」是ぜ「いる」的てき郑重说法，用よう于う描述自己じこ及および自己じこ一方いっぽう（家人けにん、同どう事じ）的まと状じょう态。
cards.detailedExplanation:
夜よるは家いえにおります。

🏗️ Sentence Structure

This sentence states a humble description of the speaker's location at a specific time, using a topic, a location, and a humble verb of existence.

[夜 [は]] [家 [に]] [おります]

🔍 Word-by-Word Breakdown

  • 夜（よる）— night · noun
  • は（は）— as for, regarding · topic particle
  • 家（いえ）— house, home · noun
  • に（に）— at, in · particle indicating location
  • おります（おります）— to be, to exist (humble form, polite) · verb (謙譲語Ⅱ)

cards.frontSentence: <ruby>片付<rt>かたづ</rt></ruby>けは<ruby>後<rt>あと</rt></ruby>でわたしが【…】。

cards.additionalNotes:

🔍 逐词与语法精讲

  • ⭐ N3 核心考点 - 謙譲語２ (丁重語):
    • 普通说法: する（します）
    • 含义: 「いたす」是ぜ「する」的てき郑重表ひょう达。
cards.detailedExplanation:
片付かたづけは後あとでわたしがいたします。

🏗️ Sentence Structure

This is a declarative sentence where the speaker states their intention to perform an action at a later time, using humble language.

[Sentence] - [Topic_Phrase] - [Noun] 片付かたづけ - [Particle] は - [Time_Adverbial] - [Noun] 後 - [Particle] で - [Subject_Phrase] - [Pronoun] わたし - [Particle] が - [Verb_Phrase] - [Verb] いたします

🔍 Word-by-Word Breakdown

  • 片付かたづけ（かたづけ）— tidying up; cleaning up · Noun
  • は（は）— as for; concerning · Topic particle
  • 後（あと）— later; afterwards · Noun (functioning adverbially)
  • で（で）— at; in; by; after (indicating time) · Particle
  • わたし（わたし）— I; me · Pronoun
  • が（が）— subject particle · Subject particle
  • いたします（いたします）— do; perform (humble form of する) · Verb (謙譲語II)

cards.frontSentence: <ruby>刺身<rt>さしみ</rt></ruby>も<ruby>日本<rt>にほん</rt></ruby><ruby>酒<rt>しゅ</rt></ruby>も【…】。
cards.backSentence: 刺身さしみも日本にほん酒しゅもいただきます。

cards.richGrammarFormation: いただく
cards.grammarExplanation: Polite humble form of 食べる/飲む
cards.additionalNotes:
None

刺身さしみも日本にほん酒しゅもいただきます。

🔍 逐词与语法精讲

  • ⭐ N3 核心考点 - 謙譲語２ (丁重語):
    • 普通说法: 食たべる・飲のむ（食たべます・飲のみます）
    • 含义: 「いただく」是ぜ吃喝的てき统一自じ谦/郑重语。
cards.detailedExplanation:
刺身さしみも日本にほん酒しゅもいただきます。

🏗️ Sentence Structure

This sentence expresses the speaker's humble intention to partake in two items, sashimi and sake, using the inclusive particle も...も and the humble verb いただきます.

[Sentence] - [Topic] - [Noun Phrase] - [Noun] 刺身 (sashimi) - [Particle] も (also) - [Noun Phrase] - [Noun] 日本酒 (sake) - [Particle] も (also) - [Predicate] - [Verb] いただきます (humbly receive/eat/drink)

🔍 Word-by-Word Breakdown

  • 刺身（さしみ）— sashimi · Noun
  • も（も）— also; too · Particle indicating inclusion or emphasis
  • 日本酒（にほんしゅ）— Japanese sake · Noun
  • も（も）— also; too · Particle indicating inclusion or emphasis
  • いただきます（いただきます）— humbly receive; humbly eat; humbly drink · Humble verb (謙譲語Ⅱ) of 食たべる (taberu, to eat), 飲のむ (nomu, to drink), or もらう (morau, to receive)

cards.frontSentence: <ruby>山中<rt>やまなか</rt></ruby>と【…】。

cards.additionalNotes:
None

山中やまなかと申もうします。

🔍 逐词与语法精讲

  • ⭐ N3 核心考点 - 謙譲語２ (丁重語):
    • 普通说法: 言いう（言いいます）

山中やまなかと申もうします。

This sentence expresses a humble self-introduction, stating the speaker's name using a quoting particle and a humble verb in its polite form.

[Sentence] - [Name:] 山中 - [Quotation Particle:] と - [Humble Polite Verb:] 申もうします

cards.frontSentence: <ruby>行き先<rt>いきさき</rt></ruby>はよく【…】。
cards.backSentence: 行き先いきさきはよく存ぞんじております。
cards.translation: I am very familiar with the destination.
cards.richGrammarFormation: <ruby>存<rt>ぞん</rt></ruby>じておる
cards.grammarExplanation: Polite humble form of 知っている
cards.additionalNotes:
None

行き先いきさきはよく存ぞんじております。

🔍 逐词与语法精讲

  • ⭐ N3 核心考点 - 謙譲語２ (丁重語):
    • 普通说法: 知しっている（知しっています）
    • 含义: 「存ぞんじておる」是ぜ表ひょう达自己じこ“知ち晓、了解りょうかい”某ぼう事じ的てき极度郑重语。
cards.detailedExplanation:
行き先いきさきはよく存ぞんじております。

🏗️ Sentence Structure

This sentence states the speaker's thorough knowledge of the destination, expressed using a humble and polite verb construction.

- [行き先いきさきは] - [よく] - [存ぞんじ] - [て] - [おり] - [ます]

🔍 Word-by-Word Breakdown

  • 行き先いきさき（ゆきさき）— destination · noun
  • は（は）— marks the topic of the sentence · topic particle
  • よく（よく）— well; thoroughly · adverb
  • 存ぞんじ（ぞんじ）— humble form of 知しる (to know) · verb stem (連用形 ren'yōkei)
  • て（て）— connects verbs, indicating a state or continuous action · conjunction particle
  • おり（おり）— humble auxiliary verb, equivalent to 「いる」, used to form the humble continuous/state form (〜ておる) · verb stem (連用形 ren'yōkei)

cards.frontSentence: いくつか<ruby>方法<rt>ほうほう</rt></ruby>があると【…】。

cards.richGrammarFormation: <ruby>存<rt>ぞん</rt></ruby>じる
cards.grammarExplanation: Polite humble form of 思う
cards.additionalNotes:
None

いくつか方法ほうほうがあると存ぞんじます。

🔍 逐词与语法精讲

  • ⭐ N3 核心考点 - 謙譲語２ (丁重語):
    • 普通说法: 思おもう（思おもいます）

cards.detailedExplanation:
いくつか方法ほうほうがあると存ぞんじます。

🏗️ Sentence Structure

This sentence expresses the speaker's humble belief regarding the existence of a few methods, using a quotative clause structure.

[Sentence] - [Subordinate Clause: いくつか方法ほうほうがある] (Content of belief) - [いくつか] (a few) - [方法] (method) - [が] (subject marker) - [ある] (to exist) - [と] (quotative particle) - [存ぞんじます] (main verb: to think/believe - humble)

  • いくつか（いくつか）— a few/several · indefinite quantity noun/adverb
  • 方法（ほうほう）— method · noun
  • が（が）— [subject particle] · subject marker particle
  • ある（ある）— to be/to exist · verb (intransitive, godan)
  • と（と）— that (quotative particle) · quotative particle
  • 存ぞんじます（ぞんじます）— to know/to think (humble form of 知しる・思おもう) · verb (ichidan, humble form)

cards.frontSentence: これは<ruby>新<rt>しん</rt></ruby><ruby>製品<rt>せいひん</rt></ruby>で【…】。
cards.backSentence: これは新しん製品せいひんでございます。
cards.translation: This is a new product.
cards.richGrammarFormation: でございます
cards.additionalNotes:
Used for polite statements without a specific object, often found in the service industry.

これは新しん製品せいひんでございます。

🔍 逐词与语法精讲

  • ⭐ N3 核心考点 - 丁寧語:
    • 普通说法: ～だ / ～です
    • 含义: 「でございます」比ひ「です」更さら加か客きゃく气、恭敬きょうけい。
cards.detailedExplanation:
これは新しん製品せいひんでございます。

🏗️ Sentence Structure

This sentence follows a basic topic-comment structure, where "これは" establishes the topic, and "新しん製品せいひんでございます" functions as the predicate, politely stating what the topic is.

[Sentence] - [Topic] - [これ] (this) - [は (topic] particle) - [Predicate] - [新製品 (new] product) - [でございます (polite] copula)

🔍 Word-by-Word Breakdown

  • これ（これ）— this · demonstrative pronoun
  • は（は）— (indicates topic) · topic particle
  • 新製品（しんせいひん）— new product · noun
  • でございます（でございます）— is/am/are (polite form of です) · polite copula

  • ⭐ N3 核心考点 - 丁寧語:

[Sentence] - [Topic] - [Noun] パソコン用よう品ひん - [Particle] は - [Location] - [Noun] 3階 - [Particle] に - [Predicate] - [Verb] ございます
